claims.statement: Ben Hogan declined Tom Allen's challenge for now, saying illness had kept him from training, and offered to fight Allen or anyone for $1,000 to $2,500 once his health improved.
claims.excerpt: But as soon as iny health improvesI will match myself,

claims.statement: Tom Allen issued a new challenge offering to fight Ben Hogan at any time within six weeks.
claims.excerpt: in which he offers to fight me at any time within six weeks

claims.statement: Ben Hogan said he fought Tom Allen while ill and untrained, and was in no condition to enter the ring.
claims.excerpt: on the day of the fightI was in no condition to enter tae ring

quotes.speaker: Ben Hogan
quotes.text: I do not wishto underrate Tom Alien, but I think if he had more muscle in his arms and less m his tongue he would bea much better man than he is.

fights.excerpt: on the day of the fightI was in no condition to enter tae ring
fights.notes: Hogan's account: he was ill and untrained. The result is not given in this card.

notes: Hogan's card, printed 1873-11-30. The Globe reported Allen's offer as ten weeks; this card says six.
